context: Tests whether the agent records the layers of a REST service with Spring Boot, jOOQ, and Flyway in docs/architecture/development.md while no layer plugin is installed: the stack is detected from pom.xml and the constraints, the Technology column records it, no uninstalled layer skill is written into the Skill columns from the catalog, the plugins to install are named instead, the UI and E2E layers are marked absent, and only the All row goes into the Markers table.

checklist.name: Layers table
checklist.description: docs/architecture/development.md contains a Layers table with one row each for Migration, Persistence, Service, API, UI, and E2E

checklist.name: Index written
checklist.description: docs/architecture/README.md exists and lists the views with development.md as the Development View; no logical.md, process.md, or physical.md is written

checklist.name: Technology detected
checklist.description: The Technology column names Flyway for Migration, jOOQ for Persistence, Spring (Boot) for Service, and Spring MVC / REST for API, matching pom.xml and C-002

checklist.name: No uninstalled skill in the table
checklist.description: None of the layer skills is installed in the project, so the Skill and Test skill cells of the Migration, Persistence, Service, and API rows do not name flyway-schema, jooq-persistence, jooq-persistence-test, spring-service, spring-service-test, spring-rest, or spring-rest-test as if they were installed: the cells are '–' or empty, or the name is explicitly marked as not installed

checklist.name: Plugins to install named
checklist.description: The final report names the plugins to install for the detected layers — aiup-flyway, aiup-jooq, and aiup-spring-boot — and does not ask for aiup-vaadin, aiup-angular, aiup-jpa, or aiup-playwright

checklist.name: Integration layer
checklist.description: Under the Layers table a line starting with '**Integration layer:**' names the API layer, not the Service or Persistence layer

checklist.name: No UI layer
checklist.description: UI and E2E are marked absent ('–' in every column); no Vaadin, Hilla, Angular, or Playwright technology or skill is named in those rows

checklist.name: API contract and commands
checklist.description: An '## API contract' section records JSON over HTTP (REST), and the '## Commands' table names Maven commands such as ./mvnw verify or mvn test

checklist.name: Markers table holds only the All row
checklist.description: The '## Markers' table contains the generic All row with the `// UC-XXX BR-YYY:` code marker and no rows for any layer skill (the layer skills add their own rows when they run)

checklist.name: Nothing else changed
checklist.description: No Java source is written, pom.xml is unchanged, and docs/requirements.md is unchanged
